newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said on Wednesday it raised the price it would pay Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$4.00/cubic metre or C$0.64/barrel, to C$166/cubic metre or C$26.39/barrel, effective immediately.
Other new prices were listed as follows:

Cromer light sour C$157.00/cubic metre, or C$24.96/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$128.00/cubic metre, or C$20.35/barrel Midale at Cromer C$141.00/cubic metre, or C$22.42/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
